author: /root/inventory
scope: read-only API research; no Lean implementation or model-equivalence proof
search_scope: Mathlib/Computability plus repository-wide searches for names NP, NPHard, NPComplete, PolyTime, PolynomialTime, TuringReduction, many-one and oracle
observations: TM0 has actual one-move/write step semantics; instantiate a fixed finite tape alphabet and finite state table.
FinTM2 requires Fintype for only the input stack alphabet, so an all-finite wrapper is necessary for this campaign.
TM2ComputableInPolyTime.comp is proof_wanted at Computable.lean:284; Batteries ProofWanted records an unmet proposition rather than supplying an axiom or theorem.
EvalsToInTime is a witness structure, and reaching some configuration does not assert its terminality.
encodeNat uses an LSB-first numeral and empty zero; the proposed prefix-framed MSB convention is intentionally explicit.

No NP/coNP, NP-hardness, polynomial many-one reduction or promised-oracle reduction definitions were found within the bounded searches. This is an API-discovery result, not a theorem that no differently named equivalent definition exists.
StackTuringMachine contains reachability/evaluation simulations; no quantitative polynomial runtime theorem was identified in the inspected source.
implementation_status: proposed specification awaiting two independent reviews
